post.yt_desc:
The US national debt passed $40 trillion on Aug 18, 2026, about $117,000 per person. This video explains the difference between the deficit and the debt, how the debt grew from $5.67 trillion in 2000, who holds it (government trust funds, the Federal Reserve, and foreign investors led by Japan, not China), and why net interest of $970 billion in fiscal 2025 cost more than national defense. We also cover the $41.1 trillion debt limit and CBO's projections, with worked examples.
